normalization: reuse exact per-fold R2D N2 source-training-fitted 0.5/99.5 percentile bounds and clipped mean/SD; no refitting, exclusions or target statistics
train_anchor_rule: 10 of 30 one-second anchors per trial: np.linspace(0,29,10,dtype=int); all 28 trials for each source-training subject; source validation and target use all 30 anchors
context_edge_rule: repeat nearest one-second window inside the same trial, exactly as frozen R2

residual_tcn.blocks: four residual depthwise-separable kernel5 blocks, dilations 1,2,4,8; GroupNorm(8), GELU, dropout 0.2
residual_tcn.head: linear 128->9

multi_resolution_cnn.branches: depthwise Conv1d 48->48 plus pointwise 48->32, GroupNorm(8), GELU
multi_resolution_cnn.post_fusion: concatenate to 96; two residual depthwise-separable kernel5 blocks with dilations 1,2; stride2 temporal downsample
multi_resolution_cnn.head: linear 96->9

conv_transformer.stem: Conv1d 32->64 kernel7 stride4 then 64->96 kernel5 stride4; GroupNorm/GELU
conv_transformer.tokens: approximately 16 at 1s and 63 at 4s, fixed sinusoidal position encoding
conv_transformer.head: linear 96->9

training.selection_metric: mean balanced accuracy across exactly twelve source-validation subjects
training.learning_rates: fixed per architecture above before target evaluation; no per-target architecture or learning-rate search

probes.emotion: source-training-only StandardScaler plus RidgeClassifier(alpha=1) on frozen source-training embeddings from the fixed 10-anchor-per-trial sample; evaluate held-out target, diagnostic only
probes.subject_id: source-training subjects only: nearest-centroid linear probe fitted on the first 21 trials per subject and evaluated on the remaining seven trials, ten fixed anchors per trial; target identity is never a probe class
probes.probe_target_usage: target embeddings and labels enter only post-checkpoint diagnostic evaluation, never model fitting or selection

trial_aggregation: mean of all 30 saved anchor probabilities inside each original video trial
optional_spatial_projection_control: deferred unless the three mandatory paired architectures finish and a source-validation rationale is documented; no topology search
